mapper.sql: dr.id, dr.claim_voucher_id, dr.deal_id, dr.deal_time, dr.deal_type, dr.deal_result, dr.comment
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO deal_record (claim_voucher_id, deal_id, deal_time, deal_type, deal_result, comment) VALUES (#{claimVoucherId}, #{dealId}, #{dealTime}, #{dealType}, #{dealResult}, #{comment})
mapper.select: SELECT , e.id AS dealer_id, e.name AS dealer_name, e.post AS dealer_post FROM deal_record dr LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.id = dr.deal_id WHERE dr.id = #{id}

SELECT , e.id AS dealer_id, e.name AS dealer_name, e.post AS dealer_post FROM deal_record dr LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.id = dr.deal_id WHERE dr.claim_voucher_id = #{claimVoucherId} ORDER BY dr.deal_time ASC
